performance.speaker: chog-witness
performance.direction: A distinct mature witness, weary and lucid; plain testimony, no supernatural growl. Stress toward only enough to overturn the official history. Closing the door was an urgent act of protection. Any memory-space reverb belongs in a later mix, never printed into the dry source.

speak.prosody: We ran toward the sea, not away from it. We were trying to close the door.
